doc_requests.documents: Please provide a valid national ID or passport showing your date of birth, clearly matching the date of birth on your application (17 January 1996), so we can complete verification. Please also confirm the correct date of birth if the application is wrong.

Because you are opening this account for Antony Ward, we need: (1) a copy of Antony Ward's valid ID/passport, (2) a signed beneficial-owner declaration from Antony Ward confirming he owns and controls the funds and the account, and (3) confirmation of the source of funds for the M$7,500 deposit. Please also tell us whether you will be acting only as card holder and whether you have any financial interest in the account.
